name: Rancho San Joaquin Golf Course
architects: William F. Bell (1964); some listings add Robert Muir Graves

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project CA_CaliforniaGaps_B23 (tile USGS_1M_11_x42y373_CA_CaliforniaGaps_B23, published 2025-08-20; from the 2023 California Gaps lidar), NAD83 / UTM 11N (EPSG:26911), NAVD88 m; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow into the release data-rancho_san_joaquin, clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/intake.py raster

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 171532123) bbox 1,007 x 1,391 m in UTM 11N (x 422244-423251, y 3724519-3725910) + about 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,280 m east-west (136 m each side), 1,792 m north-south (200 m each side)

scorecard_source: The club's printed scorecard (ranchosanjoaquin.com, RanchoSanJoaquin-Scorecard-Inside.jpg, uploaded 2021-06, fetched by the workflow 2026-10-31; release data-rancho_san_joaquin): Black, Blue and White per hole, par and two handicap rows (Black/Blue and White); rows add up to 6,431 / 6,158 / 5,709. Men's ratings from the card: Black 70.5/126, Blue 69.4/123, White 66.5/116 (women's: Black 76.8/131, Blue 75.2/129, White 73/127); GolfPass gives the same. greenskeeper.org has the same yardages and handicaps but other ratings (70.8/128, 69.7/125, 67.6/119): not used. Older card (golfingrecord, GolfPass per-hole table): Gold 6389, Blue 6154/6155, White 5624. Built: Black (back tees) and Blue (developer's overnight call 2026-10-30); default Black, the longest set (developer 2026-10-31, main).
attribution: Elevation: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (1 m DEM, 2023 California Gaps lidar)
notes: Course chat, 2026-10-31 (overnight, developer asleep: calls logged in docs/courses/rancho_san_joaquin.md). Standing defaults: every penalty area red, the OSM boundary as OB, trees from lidar, trees_off_fairways_m 2. Wind 2-10 mph as Strawberry Farms (inland Orange County, about 7 km from the sea). Theme strawberry_farms reused unchanged (the other Irvine course).

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar, project CA_CaliforniaGaps_B23 (workunit CA_CaliforniaGaps_2_B23), NAD83(2011) / UTM 11N + NAVD88 (GEOID18) m; class 1 (unclassified: vegetation and structures; no vegetation classes); 1 km tiles 11SMT422724-726, 423724-726 (423725 found through the TNM API after two guessed paths failed) (release data-rancho_san_joaquin), each clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/intake.py laz
laz.label: 2023 USGS California Gaps lidar
